sentences.text: This application coming on for hearing this day, the   following:
ORDER This is first bail application u/S.439 Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

T h e applicant has been arrested on 12.03.2022 by Police Station- Badarwas District Shivpuri (M.P.) in connection with Crime No.75/2022 for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 376 of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.

In brief, the case of the prosecution is that on 12.03.2022, mother of the prosecutrix along with her daughter who is aged about 16 years and husband lodged a report at Police Station Badarwas District Shivpuri against present applicant accused that she is having three sons and two daughters in which prosecutrix is an elder one.
Prosecutrix is weak in talking to anyone.
On 11.03.2022, in the morning by leaving prosecutrix in her home, complainant and her husband went to do labourer job.

In the evening, when they returned, prosecutrix told them about the incident happened with her that present applicant accused came in her house in the afternoon and took her in the pretext of Dhanpal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159619420/
1 "pudiya lene" in the room of Radhe Shyam Adiwasi and committed forcefully sexual intercourse with her.

sentences.text: And after leaving the prosecutrix in the aforesaid room, applicant/accused fled away.
On her report, Crime No.75/2022 for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 376 of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act was registered at Police Station Badarwas, Shivpuri.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that he has been falsely implicated in the case and further stated that the statements of prosecutrix could be recorded when FIR was lodged by her mother on the information given by the prosecutrix.
During medical examination, prosecutrix has stated to the treating Doctor that "one boy whose name she didn't know, came in her house and committed sexual intercourse".
During investigation, statements could not be recorded.
Beside this, learned advocate for the applicant filed statements of prosecutrix as well as her mother.

As per counsel for the applicant, when question put in front of prosecutrix that whether she knows the applicant, she replied No, thereafter, prosecutrix admitted that applicant took her with him, but her mother who lodged the report has denied that prosecutrix has told her that present applicant came and committed sexual intercourse with her.
Applicant is in custody since 12.03.2022 and he is permanent resident of District-Shivpuri (M.P.).
There is no possibility of his absconsion.
The applicant is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court.
With the aforesaid submissions, prayer for grant of bail is made.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor for the State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the case diary.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if applicant furnishes cash security of Rs.25,000/- alongwith a personal bail bond of Rs.25,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, he should be released on bail.
He will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.
In case of any default, cash security of Rs.25,000/- shall be forfeited without giving any notice.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance.
Certified copy/e-copy as per rules/direction.

(DEEPAK KUMAR AGARWAL) JUDGE Vijay Dhanpal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159619420/
